sources.author: Elijah Potter and Harper contributors
sources.import_policy: Use the explicit harper-weir adapter against a local v2.7.0 checkout. Do not vendor the upstream repository or bulk fixture text.
sources.notes: Evaluated fixture path: harper-core/src/linting/weir_rules/**/*.weir. The installed harper.js package contains compiled distribution files, not these source tests.

sources.author: Yue Zhang, Leyang Cui, Enbo Zhao, Wei Bi, and Shuming Shi

sources.import_policy: Use the explicit robustgec adapter against locally obtained benchmark/*/para.txt files. Never commit, bundle, or redistribute benchmark text.
sources.notes: Repository LICENSE is MIT, but benchmark text derives from CoNLL-14, BEA-19, and TEM-8. The repository does not establish that those source-data rights are replaced by its code license.

sources.author: Christopher Bryant, Mariano Felice, and contributors
sources.import_policy: Reference the published error taxonomy only. Do not add ERRANT, Python, spaCy, or model dependencies.
sources.notes: REDLINE retains its small mapped taxonomy and labels uncategorized pair-only inputs OTHER.
